title: Agent Authorization Policy Engine
hints: Turn a glob into an anchored regex: escape everything, then replace each escaped * with .*. Use fullmatch, never search.
Resolve attribute paths to a sentinel when missing, and make every condition on a missing value false. None == None must not grant access.

Collect all matching rules first. If any is a deny, the answer is deny no matter how specific the allows are. Then pick the reported rule by (resource literals, action literals, condition count), earliest rule on ties.
